thread:
rebecca: Quick brief  we need a field-ready one-pager + 300w launch post + 30m webinar hook for regulated buyers (FinServ + Healthcare). Focus: explicit SLA numbers for Hosted/Dedicated/Private, security controls, and a tiny SDR routing playbook. Draft by Tue EOD.

noah: For SLAs ops suggests: Hosted 99.9% uptime / P95 <= 125ms (1k tokens); Dedicated 99.97% uptime / P95 <= 75ms; Private: SLA negotiable (customer infra). Will confirm wording.

tanvi: I'll draft the one-pager copy and a short blog blurb. Need p95 & cost-per-1k tokens from eng. Chris, can you pull the 2k token benchmark and note batching assumptions?

chris: On it. Note: Dedicated numbers assume reserved 8xA100 with throughput batching; Hosted uses mixed-precision, small-batch serving. I'll add a one-line measurement caveat.

rebecca: Sales bullets (one column): 1) Predictable SLAs & pricing, 2) Data controls (KMS/HSM + audit logs), 3) Same API across modes, 4) Migration + automatic fallback. Include 2 quick SDR qual Qs: "Does data need to remain on-prem?" and "Estimated annual token volume?"

noah: Inbound routing pseudo-rule for HubSpot: if form contains keywords (on-prem, air-gapped, data residency) OR annual_tokens > 50M => route to enterprise_AE_queue; else => route to PS_queue. I'll add a tiny JSON snippet in assets.

tanvi: Webinar hook: "Compliant serving: latency, cost, controls"  30 mins with live canary + failover demo, plus Q&A. CTA: download compliance checklist / book a compliance scoping call. I'll draft slides.

ops-bot: Reminder: attach perf CSVs to /shared/perf/reg_launch_3922223333.csv and /shared/perf/dedicated_3922223333.csv.

rebecca: Timeline: Tanvi + Noah deliver drafts Tue EOD; Chris confirms numbers Tue noon; I'll assemble Wed morning and circulate. Thanks team :rocket:
